name: sigma-cross-org-port
description: Copy a Sigma workbook from one Sigma org into another when both orgs already read the same warehouse tables (same paths and column names) — moving a demo, template, or sample-data workbook out of a shared org into a personal or customer org. Reference-remapping over a spec copied verbatim, plus the handful of things that cannot cross an org boundary. NOT a BI-tool converter and NOT a data migration. Uses the current workbook contents endpoints (POST /v2/workbooks, PUT /{id}/contents, GET ?includeContents=true, dryRun).
